# Within: The Oracle

> An astrology app that answers your questions from your exact birth chart, in both Western (tropical) and Vedic (sidereal, Jyotish) astrology, with the dates that matter for you. 3 free questions a day; membership $9.99/month or $100/year with 14 days free. Birth details and readings stay on the user's phone.

Planet positions match Swiss Ephemeris on 99.97% of checks. Made by Praxis Global LLC, Bozeman, Montana.

## Start
- [Ask the Oracle](https://withinoracle.app/): free birth chart and personal answers
- [Birth chart guide](https://withinoracle.app/birth-chart/)
- [Synastry (two charts together)](https://withinoracle.app/synastry/)
